assumptions: Stripe data is read through payments.stripe subscriptions.list. Only a complete live-mode read can produce contact candidates or a Stripe ARPU; test-mode and partial reads are excluded.

A candidate has an active subscription with a positive recurring list price, at least minimum_paid_days after any trial, and a usable email. This is a payment-tenure/status proxy, not invoice-level payment verification or evidence of satisfaction or willingness to refer.

Gross margin and monthly churn are business inputs because subscription status does not establish either. A supplied net ARPU takes precedence; otherwise ARPU falls back to an input and currency when Stripe cannot provide a complete consistent live sample.

Gross-profit LTV is monthly ARPU multiplied by gross margin and divided by monthly churn. The total reward-cost ceiling is the lower of the allowed LTV share and current CAC when supplied. Account-credit face value divides that cost ceiling by gross margin.
One managed model call drafts copy. Stripe customer names and emails are not sent to the model. No email or page is sent or published.
cost_drivers: One bounded gpt-6-luna call for page and email copy. The configured maximum is one call, 24000 input bytes and 1400 output tokens; observed cost is not claimed by fixture cases.
At most eight read-only Stripe subscriptions.list calls through the project's restricted connection. Stripe charges and connection costs are outside Tin model accounting.
effects: Reads projected Stripe subscriptions and expanded customer contact fields through payments.stripe; test-mode or incomplete reads never yield contact candidates.
Writes reports/growth/REFERRAL_LOOP.md for owner review. Candidate customer names and emails appear only in that report.
Does not write to Stripe, send email, publish a page, or create a referral link.

cases.description: Two live active customers qualify by paid tenure, one trialing and one canceled customer do not. Yearly and monthly Stripe MRR average to USD 50.75. With 80% margin, 5% churn, 30% of LTV and USD 40 CAC, the reward ceiling is CAC-limited and the cautious two-sided credit starts at USD 12.50 each.

rubric.question: Does the reward cap follow from the stated ARPU, gross margin, churn, allowed LTV share and CAC, with no invented input?
Are listed contacts limited to live active subscribers past the paid-tenure threshold, with tenure clearly described as a proxy rather than satisfaction?
